## Bicho Cidrão (CR 1)

A transparent specter stands before you dressed in the phantom peasant garb of a shepherd, holding a glowing ghostly crook.  

**XP** 400  
LN Medium undead (incorporeal)  
**Init** +1; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +6  


**Defense**


**AC** 12, touch 12, flat-footed 11 (+1 Dex, +1 deflection)  
**hp** 18 (2d8+2)  
**Fort** +1, **Ref** +1, **Will** +4  
**Defensive Abilities** incorporeal; **Immune** undead traits  


**Offense**


**Speed** 0 ft., fly 30 ft. (perfect)  
**Melee** incorporeal touch +1 (1d8)  
**Space** 5 ft.; **Reach** 5 ft.  
**Special Attacks** horrid wail (DC 14), invisibility  


**Statistics**


**Str** -, **Dex** 13, Con -, **Int** 10, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 12  
**Base Atk** +0; **CMB** +0; **CMD** 11  
**Feats** Ability Focus (horrid wail)  
**Skills** Fly +9, Handle Animal +3, Intimidate +6, Perception +6, Stealth +6  
**Languages** Common  
**SQ** good shepherd  


**Special Abilities**



**Good Shepherd (Su)** The bicho cidrão can communicate with goats and sheep, as though continuously under the effects of the spell speak with animals. It can influence goats and sheep as per the druid ability wild empathy, using its HD as its druid level with a +4 racial modifier (total modifier +7).  

**Invisibility (Su)** The bicho cidrão can turn invisible at will, as the spell invisibility.  

**Horrid Wail (Su)** The bicho cidrão can emit a terrible keening. All living creatures within a 30-foot spread, other than sheep or goats, must succeed on a DC 14 Will save or become panicked for 2d4 rounds. This is a sonic mind-affecting fear effect. A creature that successfully saves against the wail cannot be affected by the same bicho cidrão’s wail for 24 hours. The save DC is Charisma-based.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** any mountains or plains  
**Organization** solitary  
**Treasure** incidental
